title: 点消息定位（引用块）应跳到目标消息

targets.guidance: 成员 ≥3 的群聊（会话列表头像为多人拼图，或名称含多个成员名/逗号）；@ 类问题用它
a plain text message sent by someone else, visible on screen now, containing NO link / URL / @mention (only ordinary words); the history has been scrolled up, so it is far from the latest messages
长按消息后弹出菜单里的“回复 / Reply”项

the quote card directly ABOVE my latest sent green reply bubble: it has a vertical bar on its left and shows the original sender name and quoted text — tap the sender-name line of the card (NOT the green bubble, NOT any link text)

input.text: autotest 定位链接测试（引用回复）

prepareCheck.expect: The newest message at the bottom of the chat is a green bubble saying "autotest 定位链接测试（引用回复）" with a quote card (vertical bar, quoted sender and text) directly above it

checks.expect: The chat has scrolled away from the latest messages: the newest "autotest 定位链接测试" reply bubble is NOT visible, and an older part of the conversation is shown (the quoted original message, often highlighted)

substitution.reason: ios 端当前无可用执行端（设备池只有 Android 真机，Web 用 Playwright）。替代为 android-app（同为原生移动端交互：长按/键盘/触控）或 mobile-web（同一 Web 代码的手机视口 + 触屏）；结论不能直接代表 ios 端。
